requirements.summary: Follows software engineering practices such as version control and CI/CD
requirements.statement: All components SHOULD follow modern software engineering practices, such as version control and CI/CD, and expose machine-friendly APIs (documented via schema). This ensures seamless integration with internal systems and external tooling for security, logging, observability, and traceability.

requirements.summary: Exposes machine-friendly APIs documented by a schema
requirements.statement: All components SHOULD follow modern software engineering practices, such as version control and CI/CD, and expose machine-friendly APIs (documented via schema). This ensures seamless integration with internal systems and external tooling for security, logging, observability, and traceability.

products.description: A graph-based data management platform with built-in version control, CI workflows, peer review and API access.
An agentless automation tool that manages network devices from many vendors over SSH or HTTPS, using playbooks and vendor modules.
A multi-vendor network observability application that collects device state over SSH or REST API, stores it in Parquet files and answers questions about it through a CLI, GUI, REST API or Python.
Polls multi-vendor network devices to track availability, traffic and hardware health, and shows the results in dashboards, maps and threshold-based alerts.
Collects network telemetry such as flow, SNMP and streaming telemetry from data center, cloud and internet networks, stores it, and lets users query and visualize it.
Network monitoring system that discovers devices with protocols such as SNMP, LLDP and CDP, collects their data, graphs it and sends alerts.
Monitoring software that collects metrics from network devices, servers and applications, detects problems against thresholds, sends notifications and shows the data in dashboards and maps.
Monitoring software that runs plugin-based checks against servers, network devices, websites and services, and alerts on problems, with a basic web interface.
On-premises Windows software that monitors devices, systems and traffic through sensors such as SNMP, and provides maps, dashboards, alerts and reports.
pyATS is a Python test and validation framework that records the operational state of network devices, compares it before and after changes, and runs reusable tests against the network.
NUTS is a pytest plugin that reads the desired network state from YAML test bundles, queries devices through Nornir and checks whether the results match.
Netpicker backs up device configurations and runs Python and pytest tests for configuration, compliance and security against network devices, with optional automated remediation jobs.

Nokia EDA is a Kubernetes-based platform where users declare the desired state of fabrics, interfaces and services, which it translates into multivendor device configuration and checks against streaming telemetry.
Builds a model of a hybrid network from device and cloud state and configuration, so teams can search it, verify its behavior and test proposed changes before deployment.
Discovers on-premises and cloud network devices through CLI and API calls and builds a read-only, point-in-time model of the network for analysis, compliance checks and integration.
Collects device, topology and path data from multi-vendor networks and uses it for AI-assisted diagnosis, compliance assessment and change runbooks with pre-checks and post-checks.
Discovers network devices, collects command output from them and turns it into structured inventory data that can be exported or synchronised to NetBox, Nautobot or Infrahub.

products.product: Juniper Networks Apstra Data Center Director
products.description: Manages data center fabrics across vendors: stores the intended design in a graph database, generates device configurations from it and validates the network state against it.
Provides DNS, DHCP and IP address management on hardware or virtual appliances, and pushes IP address changes to DNS and DHCP servers from a central repository.
Provides DNS, DHCP and IP address management for on-premises and cloud networks, with optional discovery, reporting and integrations with automation tools.
NetBox models and documents network infrastructure, defines its intended state and makes that data available to automation tools through APIs and a web interface.
Nautobot stores the intended state of a network in extensible data models and runs automation jobs against that data, with REST and GraphQL APIs and an app framework.
Device42 discovers and maps IT infrastructure and application dependencies across data centers and cloud, and records the results in a CMDB with DCIM, IPAM and asset management features.
dcTrack is data center infrastructure management software that records physical assets, capacity and power and network connections, and manages change requests for data center equipment.
phpIPAM is a web application for IP address management that tracks IPv4 and IPv6 subnets and addresses, VLANs, VRFs and devices, with subnet scanning and a REST API.
ServiceNow IT Service Management is a set of applications for handling IT incidents, problems, changes and service requests, with a service catalog, asset management and a CMDB.
Backstage is a framework for building developer portals around a catalog of software components, with project templates, documentation and plugins.

Linux-based application that stores network service intent and device configuration in a YANG-modelled database and pushes the resulting configuration changes to multivendor physical and virtual network devices.
Infrastructure-as-code tool that reads declarative configuration files, plans the changes needed and creates, updates or deletes cloud and on-premises resources through provider APIs.
Platform where infrastructure teams build workflows and AI agents that call existing tools such as Ansible, Python and OpenTofu, and run network changes with access control, approvals and audit logs.

Network automation platform for multivendor enterprise networks that discovers existing devices, builds intent models from their configuration, detects drift and compliance issues, and applies validated changes.
Network and IT infrastructure automation software with prebuilt integrations for third-party products that have an API or CLI, used to provision resources and manage configuration and traffic.
Infrastructure automation platform in which AI agents discover infrastructure, propose changes and apply them, with human review and policy checks; the project is archived.
Service that stores Kubernetes, infrastructure and application configuration as literal YAML or JSON data in a database, with an API and CLI to query, change, validate and version it.
Platform that runs and coordinates infrastructure-as-code workflows for Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Kubernetes and Ansible, with policies, approvals and drift detection.

products.product: The Apache Software Foundation Apache Airflow
products.description: Platform for writing workflows as Python code and for scheduling and monitoring them.
Platform for building and running scripts, workflows, internal apps and data pipelines, with schedules, webhooks and generated user interfaces.
Durable execution platform that runs application code as workflows, records each step and resumes workflows after failures.
Data orchestration platform that defines pipelines around the data assets they produce and tracks their lineage, quality and dependencies.
Workflow orchestration platform that runs Python workflows with scheduling, retries, caching and recovery.
Firewall policy analysis tool that maps hybrid network security topology, analyzes rules for risk and compliance, and recommends rule cleanup.
Network security policy management product that collects and normalizes firewall and cloud security configurations into one policy database and detects rule changes.
Network security policy management suite that analyzes firewall, cloud and SASE policies against a defined zone policy and automates access change requests.
Discontinued firewall management product that analyzed multi-vendor firewall rule bases for risk, compliance and cleanup, and tracked firewall changes.
